name: Gold Watch
tagline: Retirement send-offs worthy of the years
about: Gold Watch helps a colleague, manager or family member organise a retirement send-off: the event plan, the tribute speech, a career timeline and slideshow brief, the collection and card, and a memory jar that captures real stories.
persona: You are a thoughtful events organiser who has run dozens of retirement send-offs: you honour the years without embarrassing the person, keep speeches short and collections discreet.

onboarding.title: Send them off properly
onboarding.subtitle: Tell us who's retiring and how you know them.

profile.label: Their personality
profile.placeholder: dry humour, hates being centre of attention, loves gardening

tools.title: Plan the send-off
tools.subtitle: Run sheet, checklist, budget
tools.prompt: Plan a retirement send-off for the profile retiree at '{where}' with {guests} guests and {budget} budget, matched to their personality. Table run sheet (Time | Moment | Who | Notes) with speeches early while people are attentive; a checklist across '6 weeks out / 2 weeks / week of / on the day'; a kv budget split (venue and food, drinks, gift, printing and decor, contingency); and a callout on inviting former colleagues and on handling a retiree who says 'don't make a fuss'.

tools.title: Tribute speech
tools.subtitle: How they arrived, what they built

inputs.label: Stories, milestones, traits
inputs.placeholder: started as a porter in 1994; the night she stayed 14 hours; the famous flip-chart; 'I'll just check' catchphrase…

tools.prompt: Write a {length} {tone} retirement speech from the profile relation using: {stories}. A quote with the full speech (arc: how they arrived, what they built, who they made better, what's next, the toast); bullets on delivery and where to pause for laughs; and a callout on lines to cut if the retiree hates attention.

tools.title: Career timeline & slideshow
tools.subtitle: Slides, photos, who to ask

inputs.label: Highlights by year (rough)
inputs.placeholder: 1994 joined; 2001 promoted; 2010 led the merger; 2020 the pandemic year…

tools.prompt: Build a career timeline and slideshow brief from {highlights}. Sections: a table (Year | Milestone | Slide title | Photo or prop to find | Who to ask); then steps to collect photos and clips from colleagues within two weeks; then bullets of 6 'then vs now' slide ideas (tech, uniforms, the office, prices); then a quote with the request message to send around.

tools.title: Collection & card
tools.subtitle: Discreet kitty, easy card messages
tools.prompt: Organise a collection from {headcount} people via '{method}' toward: {gift}. Sections: a quote with the collection email (no pressure, a suggested range, deadline, who to contact); a second quote with 4 card message options of different lengths for colleagues who don't know what to write; a checklist for closing the kitty, buying, wrapping and presenting; and a callout on discretion (amounts private, include remote and part-time staff, allow anonymity).

tools.title: Memory jar & guest book
tools.subtitle: Prompts that pull real stories
tools.prompt: Set up a '{format}' for the profile retiree. Sections: bullets of 10 prompts that pull specific memories rather than 'good luck' (first impression, a time they saved the day, advice they gave, a phrase only they say); steps for running it at the event so everyone contributes; a quote with the printed instruction card; and a callout on how to present it at the end.
